name: movie_betelgeuse_isi
label: Movie: Betelgeuse's |V|^2(B) fully measured with the ISI pair at 900 nm, one baseline per night from 2.5 to 25 m
notes: The 'fully measure g2' movie: the trucks step the East-West baseline 2.5, 3.5, 4.5, 5.5, 7, 9, 12, 16, 25 m on nine nights, so the measurements walk from |V|^2 ~ 0.9 through the 5.4 m first null into the first and second sidelobes (log scale), and the joint fit of the diameter and the linear limb-darkening coefficient converges night by night.
Dead-time cap: Betelgeuse's 900 nm rate is attenuated to 4e6 cps, so the per-night precision is set by the PDM, not the star.
